criteria.text: Maintain the mandatory admission book and student fee ledger.
Maintain other essential operational records, including the Day Book and In-Out Register.
Maintain a student registry to track daily topics covered, student progress, and relevant fee details.
Maintain the basic infrastructure and facilities required for smooth centre operations.
Display the student feedback QR code and official feedback email ID in accessible locations.
Ensure that student feedback, course fee details, and related payments are recorded accurately.
Maintain student, admission, enquiry, fee, and operational information through approved records and systems.
Record college tie-ups and other institutional tie-ups in GEMS.
Maintain follow-up details for zero-paid students and students who have discontinued their courses.
Ensure adequate front office support for student enquiries, counselling, and communication.
Ensure that certificates received by the centre are handed over to the respective students without unnecessary delay.
Provide students with proper receipts or bills for fee payments.
Ensure all trainers meet the mandatory academic qualification requirements and hold valid G-TEC Certified Trainer (GCT) authorization for the courses they teach.
Ensure that trainers are available for every division and course currently offered by the centre.
Ensure mandatory attendance for the trainers training program.
Deliver the approved curriculum and maintain accurate records of batch schedules, syllabus progress, and practical learning.
Maintain suitable premises, classrooms, computer labs, and practical equipment for the courses being delivered.
Provide students with accessible feedback channels and clear information about courses, schedules, and academic support.
Ensure academic resources supplied or prescribed for courses are available to trainers and used appropriately.
Monitor student progress and follow up appropriately with students who are absent, inactive, at risk of dropping out, or have discontinued their course.
Ensure examinations and certificate processes follow approved G-TEC procedures and authorization requirements.
Student fees correspond with the approved fee structure.
No unauthorised additional charges are collected.
Collection records match available student fee records.
Pending instalments and outstanding balances are properly documented.
Financial discrepancies are reported and explained.
Applicable royalty and other payments are properly documented.
Marketing materials follow approved brand guidelines.
Only authorised logos, advertisements, and promotional claims are used.
Course details and certifications are accurately represented.
Admissions are recorded in the official system.
Student fee commitments are clearly communicated.
Unauthorised discounts and promotional offers are not provided.
Centre follows the franchise agreement and applicable organisational policies.
Centre premises and signage meet approved brand standards.
Official identity and branding are used correctly.
No unauthorised courses or services are promoted.
Centre follows approved communication and reporting procedures.
Student feedback is collected where appropriate.
Student complaints are recorded and addressed.
Students receive accurate course and fee information.
Students report that classes are conducted as promised.
Student concerns about fees, academics, or services are documented.
